Polysaccharides are complex macromolecules found in plants, algae, fungi and microorganisms. Their unique structural features and wide range of functional properties have attracted increasing scientific attention. These biopolymers exhibit diverse biological and physicochemical characteristics that make them valuable in both food and health-related applications. This review discusses recent progress in extraction techniques including enzymatic, ultrasonic and green eco-friendly approaches, which aim to improve yield and purity.
